original.statement: The 0.16 upgrade guide lists a pre-upgrade check: before upgrading, operators must confirm that no `v1alpha1` resources are used anywhere in their infrastructure (manifests, tooling, etc.).

decision.reason: [ev-d9673d74f883] lists this under the 0.16 upgrade guide's "Pre Upgrade checks": operators must make sure they are not using any `v1alpha1` resources anywhere in their infrastructure, by inspecting manifests, tooling, etc. That is a required operator step before upgrading, so a migration subject with change type migration-required fits. The kebab-case name "remove-v1alpha1-resources" describes that step. Subject and change are the only aspects reviewed here.
